Galette 1.3.2 is fresh out of the oven! 🥧

📨 Mailing recipients picked from a members search
🧾 Mass change on contributions
📎 Documents links in mails and PDF models
📋 Dynamic fields in members list, search for members without group or empty fields
🔔 New plugins releases reported
🐛 And a nice set of fixes

Fullcard and PayPal plugins are no longer maintained: move to Stripe or HelloAsso.
